description:
causal.rs defines five aggregate types that are each nothing but u64 counters summed field-wise. VERIFIED: every field of all five is u64, 43 fields total.

  FormulaWork 10, ProductWork 16, SessionWork 9, RecursiveSearchWork 6, ShiftWork 2

The duplication is already bug-shaped. FormulaWork has a private add() that sums its fields, so formula_totals() reads 'totals.add(work)'. ProductWork has no impl at all, so product_totals() hand-sums all 16 fields inline. Same idea, two shapes, and the hand-sum silently drops any field a future author forgets to add there.

Fold them into one summable mechanism so adding a counter cannot desync a totals function from its struct. Types rank highest in the fold rule.

Sequence after fz-0am: that arc changes which counters exist. Folding first would fold a set that is about to change.
title: Fold the five causal *Work counter bags into one summable shape
